title: Program Optimization & Evaluation
summary: This module provides tools for optimizing DSPy programs through automated prompt engineering and program refinement, and for evaluating their performance using various metrics.

nodes.label: Teleprompters (Optimizers)
nodes.title: Teleprompters Module
nodes.description: Contains various optimizers (teleprompters) for automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and program refinement using techniques like evolutionary search, RL, and Bayesian optimization.

nodes.label: Evaluation Metrics
nodes.title: Evaluation Metrics Module
nodes.description: Provides a suite of metrics for evaluating the performance of language model programs, including semantic F1, completeness, groundedness, and exact match scores.

nodes.label: Optimization Utilities
nodes.title: Optimization Utilities Module
nodes.description: Offers utility functions supporting program optimization, such as patching forward passes for tracing, appending rules/demonstrations, and logging token usage during trials.

nodes.label: Program Execution & Primitives
nodes.title: Program Execution & Primitives
nodes.description: The core DSPy modules and primitives that define and execute programs, which are the targets of optimization.

nodes.label: Language Model Integration
nodes.title: Language Model Integration
nodes.description: Modules responsible for interacting with various language models, providing the underlying LMs used by optimizers and programs.

edges.label: optimizes
edges.title: Optimizes DSPy Programs
edges.description: Teleprompters apply various strategies to improve the performance of DSPy programs by modifying their instructions or demonstrations.

edges.label: uses for feedback
edges.title: Uses Metrics for Feedback
edges.description: Optimizers rely on evaluation metrics to assess the quality of program outputs and guide the optimization process.

edges.label: leverages utilities
edges.title: Leverages Optimization Utilities
edges.description: Teleprompters use helper functions from the optimization utilities for tasks like tracing, rule generation, and logging.

edges.label: interacts with LMs
edges.title: Interacts with Language Models
edges.description: Optimizers interact with language models to generate new prompts, evaluate responses, or fine-tune models.

edges.label: can use LMs for auto-evaluation
edges.title: Can Use LMs for Auto-Evaluation
edges.description: Some advanced evaluation metrics leverage language models to perform semantic comparisons and groundedness checks.

edges.label: monitors program execution
edges.title: Monitors Program Execution
edges.description: Utilities like patched forward passes monitor and trace the execution of DSPy programs to gather data for optimization.

groups.label: Optimization Core
groups.title: Core Optimization Logic
groups.description: The central component housing all teleprompters responsible for automated program improvement and prompt engineering.

groups.label: Evaluation & Support
groups.title: Evaluation and Support Tools
groups.description: Provides the necessary tools for measuring program performance and utility functions to aid the optimization process.

groups.label: External DSPy Modules
groups.title: Dependencies on Other DSPy Modules
groups.description: This module relies on core DSPy program definitions and language model integrations to function.
